# netcup_scp_server_snapshot (Resource)

Manages snapshots of a netcup SCP virtual server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_server_snapshot" "example" {
  server_id       = 1234
  name            = "terraform-snapshot"
  description     = "Managed by Terraform"
  disk_name       = "vda"
  online_snapshot = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to snapshot.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot.
- `disk_name` (String) Name of the disk to snapshot. If omitted the whole server is snapshotted.
- `online_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot should be created while the server is running.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
- `disks` (List of String) List of disk names included in the snapshot.
- `download_infos` (Attributes) Download information available after the snapshot is exported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--download_infos))
- `exported` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot has been exported.
- `exported_size_in_ki_b` (Number) Size of the exported snapshot in KiB.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier, set to the snapshot name.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot was created online.
- `state` (String) Current state of the snapshot.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the snapshot assigned by SCP.

<a id="nestedatt--download_infos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `download_infos`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String) Filename of the exported snapshot.
- `headers` (Map of List of String) HTTP headers required to download the snapshot.
- `presigned_url` (String) Presigned URL for downloading the exported snapshot.
- `presigned_url_validity_duration_in_hours` (Number) Validity of the presigned URL in hours.
